_comment: Gundam Universal Century manual watch order, drafted 2026-09-12, movie-trilogy swap-in added 2026-09-15. Supersedes the SmartLists version (IMDb list ls560971030, 'Gundam: Continuity Order') for two reasons the external list can't express: (1) mid-sequence placements no provider list supports (same limitation as Trigun/Votoms/.hack/Steins;Gate, see README) -- 'Mobile Suit Gundam: Cucuruz Doan's Island' (2022, theatrical remake of TV ep 15) and 'G-Saviour' (2000, live-action UC 0223 endpoint, appended after Victory Gundam); (2) deliberate choice (2026-09-15, community-supported per digitalcitizen.life/peepstune.com watch-order guides) to use the 1981-82 Mobile Suit Gundam movie trilogy (Radarr ids 113/115/123, all hasFile:true, titles verified exact-match against Jellyfin) INSTEAD OF grabbing the 43-episode 1979 TV series (Sonarr id 170, deliberately left unmonitored) -- the trilogy covers the same story in ~7h vs ~17h and is the commonly-recommended entry point. Trilogy-to-episode mapping (confirms Doan's Island's slot): Movie I = TV ep 1-13, [ep 14-15 gap -- Doan's Island covers ep 15], Movie II = ep 16-30, Movie III = ep 31-43. IGLOO trilogy internal order corrected from release order to in-story chronology per Gundam Wiki/community sourcing (2026-09-12 session): Hidden One Year War (early war) -> Gravity Front (Battle of Odessa, mid-war) -> Apocalypse 0079 (final month, Solomon/A Baoa Qu) -- NOT release order, which is Hidden One Year War / Apocalypse 0079 / Gravity Front. Still blocked as of 2026-09-15 on real missing content (not title strings): both IGLOO movies, G-Saviour, and Mobile Suit Gundam Narrative (all hasFile:false in Radarr), plus Gundam ZZ (Sonarr id 168, monitored but 0/47 episode files). watch-orders-runner retries this file every daily sweep automatically, so no manual trigger is needed once each lands -- see README. Title-string bugs found and fixed live 2026-09-15 (build_playlist.py does exact-match lookup, so these silently blocked the whole file): Radarr uses an en-dash not a hyphen for 'The Origin IV/VI', a colon not a dash for 'The Origin V: Clash at Loum', 'Mobile Suit Gundam Narrative' has no colon, Hathaway's real title is 'MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The Sorcery of Nymph Circe', and IGLOO 2 (Gravity Front) is season 3 of the combined Sonarr series 'Mobile Suit Gundam: MS IGLOO' (id 172, TVDB 81104), not its own series named 'MS IGLOO 2'. Every remaining title has been verified live against Sonarr/Radarr's exact stored title -- any future SystemExit here means the library title itself changed (re-verify, don't guess), not a stale placeholder.
